title: Spear RDC Opal White complete bike
notes: SEKA's own XHS account shares studio photos of a complete Spear RDC in Opal White, built with Shimano Dura-Ace, Scope wheels and Pirelli P Zero tyres. No price, weight, size or tyre width is stated; the parts are a sample build, not a SEKA complete-bike SKU.
